content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the KRCL recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Konkan Railway Corporation recruitment is Senior Technical Assistant/S&T.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Technical Assistant/S&T post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Senior Technical Assistant/S&T post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Technical Assistant/S&T post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Technical Assistant/S&T post is 33 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: A four years Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering or M.Sc Electronics or a combination of any sub-stream is required.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 01 year of experience in Signal and Telecom Systems is mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Senior Technical Assistant/S&T post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 50060 - 57140 Per Month, with consolidated remuneration varying based on class (A, B, C).

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview venue is at the KRCL office in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra (Pincode: 400614).
